Everton supporters staged a sit-in at Goodison Park for a second week running after Saturday's 4-0 defeat by Brentford, with several thousand fans remaining in the Gwladys Street end for twenty minutes after the final whistle. A banner reading "SIXTEEN YEARS OF FAILURE" was unfurled in the lower tier. Supporters' trust chair Denise Barrett-Baxendale said the mood had hardened: "People are furious, and they have every right to be. This board has treated a great club with contempt." Manager David Moyes said he understood the anger and would not criticise the protest. Everton have taken four points from their opening seven fixtures.
